The patch adds a check that rejects non-ARPHRD_ETHER slaves when the bond mode is 8023AD, and the commit message explicitly states "BOND_MODE_8023AD makes sense for ARPHRD_ETHER only." The issue was introduced by commit 872254dd6b1f ("net/bonding: Enable bonding to enslave non ARPHRD_ETHER") which removed the Ethernet-only restriction.
